import hashlib, importlib.metadata as m, importlib.util, json, os
from pathlib import Path
import platform, site, sys
import compliant_control_lab
import tools.learning_deployment.cli as cli
from compliant_control_lab.surface_experiment import _source_hashes
from tools.learning_deployment.common import runtime_identity
package = Path(compliant_control_lab.__file__).resolve().parent
tools = Path(cli.__file__).resolve().parents[1]
expected = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
tools_hashes = {name: hashlib.sha256((tools/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                for name in expected["packaged_tools"]}
loaded_sources = {
    name: str(Path(module.__file__).resolve())
    for name, module in sys.modules.copy().items()
    if (name == "compliant_control_lab" or name.startswith("compliant_control_lab.")
        or name == "tools" or name.startswith("tools."))
    and getattr(module, "__file__", None)
}
print(json.dumps({
    "prefix":sys.prefix,"base_prefix":sys.base_prefix,"sys_path":sys.path,
    "user_site_enabled":site.ENABLE_USER_SITE,"isolated_flag":sys.flags.isolated,
    "torch_unavailable":importlib.util.find_spec("torch") is None,
    "torch_not_imported":not any(n=="torch" or n.startswith("torch.") for n in sys.modules),
    "package_path":str(package),"cli_path":cli.__file__,"loaded_sources":loaded_sources,
    "package_hashes":_source_hashes(),"packaged_tools":tools_hashes,
    "runtime_identity":runtime_identity(),"python_version":platform.python_version(),
    "platform":platform.platform(),"machine":platform.machine(),
    "installed_versions":{name:m.version(name) for name in expected["locked_versions"]},
    "project_version":m.version("compliant-control-lab"),
}))
